_README.format: Array of fixture objects. Each has: query (string), relevantIds (array of memory UUIDs that SHOULD appear in the top results), and note (human-readable explanation). relevantIds are obtained by running `GET /api/v1/memories/context?query=<query>` manually and copying the UUIDs from sources[] that are genuinely relevant. Leave relevantIds empty ([]) until you have populated them — the harness will warn and skip scoring for that fixture.
_README.workflow: 1. Run harness once with empty relevantIds to see what the server currently returns (keyword baseline). 2. Copy relevant UUIDs into relevantIds. 3. Re-run to get scored metrics. 4. After enabling embeddings, re-run and compare.
_README.uuidSource: GET /api/v1/memories/context?query=<url-encoded-query>&budgetTokens=4000&maxSources=10&hops=1 — look at sources[].id in the response
